title: brainy: bd auto-init missing --external flag for shared-server mode
description: hooks/check-beads-init.js and scripts/prd-seed.mjs both ran 'bd init --shared-server' without --external. On Windows with the global shared Dolt server already running at ~/.beads/shared-server/, this fails silently: bd tries to start a second server on the bound port 3308 and bails mid-init, leaving a corrupt .beads/ dir. Root cause traced in beads source at internal/doltserver/doltserver.go IsRunning() which deletes pid/port files when Win32_Process probe doesn't confirm the process. Fixed by adding --external --non-interactive to both call sites and to setup.md workflow doc. Memory saved at feedback_bd_init_shared_server_external.md.
close_reason: Fixed in commit on chore/brainy-remove-wispr-granola — 3 brainy call sites + memory + setup workflow updated.

title: Remove Wispr and Granola skills from Brainy
description: User-specific paid-tool integrations don't belong in the universal plugin. Deleted skills/wispr and skills/granola entirely, stripped references from 6 files, bumped v1.24.0 -> v1.25.0. Shipped in PR #9 on branch chore/brainy-remove-wispr-granola.
